Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 38/100 (Unsettled) · 14 Alert · 42 Watch · 33 Normal Headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz as the US widens its campaign to Iran's land routes; a Houthi missile attack damages an Aramco building in Riyadh on 8 Nov. Russia's 7 Nov barrage hit nuclear-linked substations before Abu Dhabi talks.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: US launches Iron Gate task force on 7 Nov; Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz; missile attack damages Aramco building in Riyadh on 8 Nov. Brent near $98. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, uk-energy-cap, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: Russia's 7 Nov barrage of 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles hit nuclear-linked substations, Kyiv says; Abu Dhabi talks set for 10–11 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.5 for Aug–Oct; record warmth for the date on 1 Nov; CO₂ growth 3.3 ppm/yr; drought threat in southern Africa and Asia. → alert: enso, global-temp, co2; watch: drought, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: WHO counts 10,668 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,198 deaths in DR Congo to 3 Nov; cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO PHEIC since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Drone strikes push Sudan's power grid near collapse (AP, 1 Nov); Khartoum accuses Ethiopia of drone strikes on 3 Nov; IPC warns of famine risk. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread about 152bp on 6 Nov (OFCE: 163bp on 3 Nov); Fitch outlook negative on 3 Nov; mass strikes on 5 Nov; budget deadline 17 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov; euro-area inflation hit 4.0% in October and ECB officials signal more hikes. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
